translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: God Israelian apaniba bar me agɨvasa, gumazim God ko mɨgei
Godɨn ziam fer ighiam, Asap an osiri.

content.text: O God, nɨ akam dukuagh pura ganan markɨ.
Nɨ pura uabɨn asugh nɨmɨra ikian markɨ.
Nɨ gan, nɨn apaniba me mɨdoroziba fori da otifi.
Ezɨ gumazir nɨn aghuaziba nɨn akaba batosi.
Me nɨn gumazamiziba paza me damuasa muegha me bagha gara iti.
Gumazamizir nɨn apengan iti nɨ eghuvir kaba,
gumazir kurar kaba me gasɨghasɨghasa.
Me ghaze,
“Ia izɨ e Israelɨn kantri bar a gasɨghasightɨ,
a ziaba puvatɨghtɨ, me uam a gɨnɨghnɨghan kogham.”
Kantrin kaba Israel abɨnasa uari akuvagha,
nɨghnɨzir vamɨram amigha akam mɨsoke.
Ikɨzir kabanang: Idomia, Ismaelia, Moapia, Hakria, ko
Gebalia, Amonia, Amalekia, Filistia, ko Tairɨn nguibamɨn gumazamiziba.
Asirian kantri uaghan men aven ghugha Moapia ko, Amonian akura.
Me Lotɨn ovavir borir bar gavgaviba.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: O God, nɨ faragha Midiania gamizɨ moghɨn nɨ me damigh.
Nɨ kamaghɨra Kisonɨn Fanemɨn Sisera ko, Jabin aning gasɨghasɨki.
Nɨ dughiar kamɨn Endorɨn nguibamɨn aning gasɨghasɨghizɨ,
aningɨn kuamning ikia kuri.
Nɨ faragha Orep ko, Sep gamizɨ moghɨn,
nɨ men mɨdorozir gumazir dapanibar amigh.
Men gumazir dapaniba, nɨ faragha Seba ko, Salmuna gamizɨ moghɨn me damigh.
Gumazir kaba bar ghaze,
“E Godɨn nguazir bar aghuir kam inigh an afeziam ikegham.”
O God, nɨ uan amɨnir gavgavimɨn me giveraghtɨ,
me mɨnezibar mɨn mɨghɨ tintinibar mangegh gɨvagham.
Nɨ me giveraghtɨ, mati amɨnim raizɨn mɨsevibagh iverazɨ,
da mɨgha ghuezɨ moghɨn, me mɨghɨ mangegh.
Avim ruariba ko mɨghsɨabar isia akara zui moghɨn,
nɨ men agɨntɨghtɨ me aregh.
Kamaghɨra, nɨ amozir ekiam amadaghtɨ a izɨ men agɨraghtɨ me aregh.
Nɨ amɨnir ekiam amadaghtɨ, a izɨtɨ me atiating.
O Ikiavɨra Itir God,
Nɨ me damightɨ me okam nɨghnɨgh bar aghumsigh,
nɨ baghvɨra ikiam.
Nan ifongiam, nɨ me abɨraghtɨ me bar atiatingigh aghumsigh kamaghɨra ikɨ.
Nɨ aghumsɨzim me danigh, me mɨsueghtɨ me arɨmɨghiregh.
Nɨ kamagh damightɨ me guizbangɨra ganigh fogh suam,
“Nɨ bar uabɨra nɨn ziam, Ikiavɨra Itir God.
Nɨrara Godɨn Bar Pɨn Itim,
egha nguazir oteviba bar dagh ativagha dar gari.”
